title: Drivers — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21).

items.title: Surface /drivers renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: NOT YET VERIFIED. Surface enumerated from the route manifest on 2026-07-29. To reach PASS this route must be opened in the running app and shown to render real entity-scoped data (TRANSP and USMCA), every rendered field present in the submit payload where it writes, and forward/reverse linkage proven. No claim is made here beyond the route existing.
